question: An electric current is expressed by a unit called __ __ .
solution:
The correct answer is __**ampere**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Electric current is expressed by a unit called the ampere (A)__, named after the French scientist Andre-Marie Ampere.

 __
 
• ​Ampere can be defined as one unit of charge flown through a given circuit in one second.
